title: Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions — Benefit Uses Allowed per Term
content:
Each Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions product allows a fixed number of benefit uses in one term. A use is one covered bag direction or one covered seat segment for one traveler.

| Subscription | Most benefit uses per term |
|---|---|
| Crestline Bag Pass One | 150 |
| Crestline Bag Pass Two | 150 |
| Crestline Seat Pass Domestic | 150 |
| Crestline Seat Pass Network | 150 |
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Domestic | 200 |
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Network | 200 |

**Illustration (hypothetical counts).** The Bag Passes and the Seat Passes allow 150 uses per term; the two Seat and Bag Passes allow 200. A Seat and Bag Pass Domestic holder with 150 uses recorded in the current term is still within that subscription's allowance of 200, while a Seat Pass Domestic holder with the same 150 uses has reached that subscription's allowance of 150.
